record.paper_title: Harvesting and stocking in discrete-time contest competition models with open problems and conjectures
record.context_brief: Largest persistent set under quota permutation
record.original_question: For the Beverton-Holt periodic harvesting equation x_{n+1} = K mu x_n/(K + (mu - 1)x_n) - h_n, suppose a fixed p-periodic multiset of harvesting quotas h_0, h_1, ..., h_{p-1} gives a nonempty persistent set. Among all permutations of those quotas, which ordering produces the largest persistent set of initial populations whose trajectories survive indefinitely?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider the Beverton–Holt periodic harvesting difference equation
  x_{n+1} = K·μ·x_n / (K + (μ − 1)·x_n) − h_n,
where K > 0 is the carrying capacity, μ > 1 is the intrinsic growth ratio, and {h_n}_{n≥0} is a nonnegative p-periodic sequence of harvesting quotas determined by a fixed multiset H = {h_0, h_1, …, h_{p−1}}. For a given ordering σ of H (a p-periodic extension of a permutation of the multiset), define the persistent set
  P(σ) = { x_0 ≥ 0 : the trajectory generated by the recurrence with quotas h_n = σ(n mod p) satisfies x_n ≥ 0 for all n ≥ 0 }.
Assume that for some ordering of H the persistent set is nonempty.

Problem: Among all orderings σ of the multiset H, determine which permutation maximizes the persistent set P(σ) (with respect to set inclusion, or, failing that, with respect to Lebesgue measure on the real line), and characterize this optimal ordering explicitly in terms of H, K, and μ.
artifact.category_tag: Discrete-time population models with periodic harvesting
artifact.status_search_result: The question of which permutation of a fixed multiset of periodic harvesting quotas yields the largest persistent set of initial conditions for the Beverton–Holt model is explicitly stated as an open problem. Related work has characterized when permutations leave the population geometric mean invariant (e.g., permutations in the dihedral group, and block-reflection results on the effect of permutations on the global attractor), but no full characterization of the maximizing ordering for the persistent set has been published. The problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: The effect of maps permutation on the global attractor of a periodic Beverton–Holt model
status_evidence.snippet: Characterizes when permutations of harvesting quotas leave the geometric mean invariant via dihedral-group and block-reflection arguments, but does not resolve which permutation maximizes the persistent set.
status_evidence.claim: Partial results exist on the effect of permutations, but the optimal ordering for the persistent set is not characterized.

status_evidence.title: The Beverton–Holt model with periodic and conditional harvesting
status_evidence.snippet: Studies persistence and harvesting in the periodic Beverton–Holt model and discusses the influence of the ordering of harvesting quotas.
status_evidence.claim: Persistence under periodic harvesting is studied, but the maximizing permutation question remains an open problem.
